name: Granite-Wrath
description: Granite-Wrath is a world in constant geological fury, its surface a battlefield of colliding tectonic plates that thrust granite batholiths skyward only to be torn apart by rift valleys and drowned in fresh magma. Supervolcanoes erupt on decadal cycles, each eruption reshaping hundreds of square kilometers and ejecting plumes of ash that circle the globe. The granite itself is remarkable, shot through with large feldspar crystals and mica that gleam in the volcanic light.

The toxic atmosphere is a corrosive soup of sulfur dioxide, hydrochloric acid, and volcanic ash that eats through standard protective equipment in hours. Acid rain falls continuously in the lowlands, pooling in caustic lakes that dissolve exposed rock into bizarre pinnacle formations. The heat is oppressive even at altitude, and the ground trembles with a frequency that suggests the entire crust is in perpetual motion.

Granite-Wrath was quarantined after a biological weapons research facility was destroyed by a volcanic event, its containment systems compromised. The nature of the research and the extent of contamination remain classified, though the quarantine zone encompasses the entire planet. Whether the volcanic conditions have neutralized the biological agents or merely preserved them beneath fresh layers of stone is a question no one has been authorized to answer.

The quarantine makes Granite-Wrath officially off-limits, but its uranium deposits and geothermal potential ensure that the restriction is routinely tested by unauthorized prospectors. The military maintains an orbital monitoring station but lacks the resources for continuous enforcement. The planet's own violence may be the most effective quarantine measure; Granite-Wrath destroys its own surface regularly enough that anything buried is soon entombed beyond practical recovery.
